title: CannyForge Longitudinal Task Family
description: Reusable task-family definition for the longitudinal benchmark harness.

task_family.description: Primary reusable pattern identifier used for transfer and reporting.

variant_id.description: Unique identity for one task phrasing or state variant inside a task family.

domain.description: Benchmark domain, such as fsi, coding, data, or mcp.

difficulty.description: Difficulty bucket inherited from prior benchmark design.

window_role.description: Dataset role hint used when constructing streams.

transfer_cluster.description: Cluster label that replaces FSI80 confusion_pair semantics.

failure_family.description: Canonical failure family this task is intended to exercise.

user_request.description: Canonical user request text for the task variant.

success_type.description: Primary completion contract, such as completed_workflow or final_answer.

required_tools.description: Tools that must appear for the task to count as complete.

final_artifact.description: Optional expected artifact type or final answer shape.

expected_outcome.description: Completion target for the task family.

expected_sequence.description: Ordered tool dependency chain when sequence matters.

expected_arg_contains.description: Expected argument fragments keyed by tool name.

distractor_tools.description: Tools that are plausible but wrong for this task family.

environment_template.description: Template state used to render concrete task episodes.

scoring_contract.description: Explicit evaluator contract for the task family.
